units.source_text: 菅公贬官时有诗云：“行行一步一回头，

en.t: When Sugawara no Michizane was demoted and sent away, he wrote a poem saying: "As I walked on, with every step I turned back to look,
and still I could see the dense green trees around your house.

units.source_text: 直到树梢望不见，茫茫前途是离愁。”

en.t: When even the treetops could no longer be seen, the vast road ahead was nothing but the sorrow of parting."
This appears in the Shūi Wakashū.
